sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Plugged into the front of PCs

- Buried barrel cache
- Common fund stash (Shturman's stash)
- Dead Scav
- Drawer
- Ground cache
- Jacket
- PC block
- Plastic suitcase
- Safe
- Sport bag
- Weapon box (6x6)

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: - A tent south-west of the lumber camp on Woods has a dedicated spawn for up to 2 possible flash drives at once

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- A campsite west of the two-story dorms on Customs has a dedicated spawn for up to 2 possible flash drives at once

- On the bed of dorm room 110 in the two-story dorms on Customs

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - Easter eggs and References: This item is based off Kingston's "IronKeyTM Encrypted Flash Drives".
